subject.title: Subagent announce give-up (retry-limit/expiry) does not wake parent waiting on sessions_yield → permanent deadlock

question: Should this issue be scoped to the narrow retry-limit/expiry parent wake fix, with retry/expiry config and durable queued announcements tracked separately, or should it wait for the broader durable queue design?
rationale: The wake bug is source-reproducible, but the requested config knobs and durable recovery strategy affect public config/product surface beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Land narrow wake fix
options.body: Review and land the bounded parent-wake behavior in the existing candidate PR, then keep retry/expiry configurability and durable queue work as separate follow-ups.

options.title: Wait for durable queue design
options.body: Hold the issue until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94153 or an equivalent persistent delivery queue is ready to replace direct retry give-up semantics.

options.title: Bundle config knobs now
options.body: Expand the fix to include configurable retry limits and expiry windows, accepting new public config surface and requiring docs/schema/upgrade review.

recommendation.title: Land narrow wake fix
recommendation.body: Review and land the bounded parent-wake behavior in the existing candidate PR, then keep retry/expiry configurability and durable queue work as separate follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent subagent lifecycle work and repository product/config policy make this the best available routing owner from the code history.
